versions.content: When adding the first contained I - PDU to a Container PDU with the parameter IpduMContainerTxFirstCo ntainedPduTrigger set to TRUE, IpduM shall call PduR_IpduMTransmit.
When adding the first contained I - PDU to a Container PDU with the parameter IpduMContainerTxFirstCo ntainedPduTrigger set to TRUE, IpduM shall call PduR_IpduMTransmit.

When assigning a transmission request of a contained I - PDU to a Container PDU with the parameter IpduMContainerTxFirstCo n tained PduTrigger set to TRUE, the Container PDU shall be queue d for tranmission .

When assigning a transmission request of a contained I-PDU to a Container PDU with the parameter IpduMContainerTxFirstContainedP- duTrigger set to TRUE, the Container PDU shall be queued for transmission.
